xdg_config_dirs.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for menu files. Default is /etc/xdg.

xdg_data_dirs.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for desktop files. Default includes /usr/local/share and /usr/share.

xdg_config_home.description: Directory for user-specific menu files (modified menus). Default is ~/.config.

xdg_data_home.description: Directory for user-specific desktop files (new/modified applications). Default is ~/.local/share.

xdg_menu_prefix.description: Prefix for the main menu file name (e.g., 'gnome-' results in gnome-applications.menu). Empty string uses applications.menu.
